settings.title: Academy settings
settings.subtitle: Tenant identity, look and feel, seasonal schedule, academic catalog, and SEPA billing — ready for multiple locations.
settings.hex_invalid: Use a hex color such as #2563EB.
settings.currency_invalid: Currency must be a 3-letter ISO code.
settings.general_help: Legal and trade identity for this tenant. Timezone drives daily attendance generation. Future locations will hang off this academy.
settings.appearance_help: Design tokens, brand assets, and professional presets. Changes preview instantly as CSS variables.
settings.brand_help: White-label assets and palette used in the workspace chrome.
settings.presets_help: Apply a complete token catalog. You can still fine-tune any value afterwards.
settings.preset_tatami_help: Classic dojo: deep red, gold, charcoal chrome, subtle corners.
settings.preset_modern_help: Contemporary academy: royal blue, slate, rounded surfaces.
settings.preset_performance_help: Elite athletic: green and cyan, compact density, flat elevation.
settings.assets_help: Hosted image URLs. Upload storage is out of scope; paste HTTPS links.
settings.logo_url_help: Horizontal mark shown in the top bar.
settings.isotype_url_help: Compact mark for the sidebar and favicon.
settings.pdf_logo_url_help: Used on invoices and graduation diplomas.
settings.tokens_brand_help: Primary actions, secondary CTAs, and text sitting on the primary fill.
settings.tokens_surfaces_help: Application canvas, cards, sidebar, top bar, and footer.
settings.tokens_semantic_help: Success, warning, error, and informational states.
settings.tokens_type_help: Font family and global scale for accessibility.
settings.tokens_geometry_help: Corner radius, density, and card elevation.
settings.appearances_help: Start from a system preset or a saved custom appearance, then tweak tokens. System presets cannot be edited or deleted.
settings.appearances_base_help: Loads the selected catalog into the studio and activates it for the workspace.
settings.appearances_custom_help: Custom catalog stored for this academy.
settings.appearances_save_as_help: Stores the current tokens under a custom name. System presets stay unchanged.
settings.appearances_name_required: Enter a name between 2 and 80 characters.
settings.appearances_rename_help: Only the title changes. Tokens stay as they are until you save or update them.
settings.appearances_delete_confirm: Delete “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone. The live workspace tokens are kept.
settings.appearances_empty: No custom appearances yet. Tweak a preset and save it as a new appearance.
settings.schedule_help: Stable weekly calendar used to generate daily attendance sessions. Grouped Monday to Sunday.
settings.schedule_empty: No weekly slots yet. Add the first class below.
settings.delete_slot_confirm: Delete this weekly slot? Existing sessions stay in history.
settings.ages_help: Global brackets used by the student directory, license wizard, and attendance roster. They cross-cut every discipline.
settings.programs_help: Training programs and belt ranks live here. Billing and SEPA stay on the Billing tab.
settings.delete_program_confirm: Delete this training program and its belt ranks?
settings.billing_help: Creditor IBAN and SEPA Creditor ID used for mandates and pain.008. Stripe can be connected later without touching academic data.
settings.finance_help: Creditor IBAN, tax id, and invoicing address belong to the financial bounded context.

federations.title: Federation catalog
